reason: A GitHub integration for agent-assisted pull request, issue, repository, search, review, and CI workflows, including approval-gated write operations.

summaries.zh: 连接 GitHub，支持代理读取和搜索仓库、文件、拉取请求与议题，并在批准后执行评论、更新、合并及 CI 审查操作。
summaries.en: Connects agents to GitHub for reading and searching repositories, files, pull requests, and issues, with approval-gated comments, updates, merges, and CI review operations.

capabilities: Reads GitHub repositories, files, pull requests, issues, comments, and CI results
Creates, updates, comments on, closes, reviews, and merges GitHub pull requests or issues
Runs background review jobs and CI-related review workflows
Uses outbound network access and declares filesystem write capability
